title: 青馬大橋~Tsing Ma Bridge
focus: 颱風區公路鐵路兩用雙層懸索橋：鐵路線形、遮蔽車道、空中紡線主纜與 WASHMS 長期監測~A typhoon-zone road–rail double-deck suspension bridge: rail geometry, sheltered lanes, air-spun cables and WASHMS long-term monitoring
summary: 青馬大橋主跨 1,377 m，1997 年通車，上層六線公路、下層兩條鐵路軌道與兩條有遮蔽的車道，是承載鐵路的最長跨徑懸索橋。本課從鐵路對橋面坡度與變位的要求、颱風下的行車安全出發，計算空中紡線主纜的主跨與邊跨鋼絲數差異，說明滑模混凝土塔、96 個橋面模組吊裝、伸縮縫與軌道銜接，再以香港路政署的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS）、交通量與水上淨空管制，說明營運維護。~Tsing Ma Bridge has a 1,377 m main span and opened in 1997, carrying six road lanes above and two rail tracks plus two sheltered carriageways below, the longest-span suspension bridge carrying rail. The course starts from rail demands on deck gradient and deflection and from vehicle safety in typhoons, derives the difference in wire count between main and side spans of the air-spun cables, explains slipformed concrete towers, lifting 96 deck modules, expansion joints and track continuity, then uses the Highways Department's Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS), traffic data and marine air-draft control to explain operation and maintenance.

units.anchor: 下層鐵路軌道坡度~Lower-deck rail gradient
units.title: 鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制~Rail loading and deck deflection limits
units.mechanism: 公路車輛可以容忍懸索橋在活載下數公尺的起伏，鐵路卻對縱坡變化、軌道扭曲與橋端轉角非常敏感，因為列車的懸吊與輪軌接觸需要平順的幾何。青馬大橋把鐵路放在下層、位於加勁梁的剪力中心附近，並以深桁架提供足夠的彎曲與扭轉勁度；但懸索橋的豎向勁度主要仍來自主纜，半跨加載時的反對稱變形最為不利，會在跨內形成一升一降的波形，使局部坡度增加。設計必須把這種變形換算成軌道坡度與豎曲線半徑，與鐵路營運限值比較。~Road vehicles tolerate several metres of live-load movement on a suspension bridge, but rail is very sensitive to gradient change, track twist and end rotation, because train suspension and wheel–rail contact need smooth geometry. Tsing Ma places the railway on the lower deck near the shear centre of the stiffening girder and uses a deep truss for bending and torsional stiffness; yet vertical stiffness still comes mainly from the cables, and half-span loading producing antisymmetric deformation is most adverse, forming a rise and a dip within the span that steepens local gradients. Design must convert this deformation into track gradient and vertical-curve radius and compare them with railway operating limits.
units.model: 設反對稱變形為正弦半波，半波長 λ = l/2 = 688.5 m、振幅 A = 2.35 m，最大附加坡度 = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107，即約 1.07%。若振幅減半，附加坡度約 0.54%；這個附加值要與橋面原有縱坡相加後再與鐵路容許坡度比較。數值為教學假設。~Treat the antisymmetric deformation as a sine half-wave with λ = l/2 = 688.5 m and amplitude A = 2.35 m: the maximum added gradient = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107, about 1.07%. Halving the amplitude gives about 0.54%; this addition must be combined with the deck's built-in gradient and compared with the permitted rail gradient. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以有限元素模型對公路與鐵路荷載做半跨、全跨與偏心加載組合，輸出軌道高程、坡度、扭曲與橋端轉角；完工後以實際列車與測試車隊做載重試驗，以精密水準與 GNSS 量測變位並與預測比較。~Run half-span, full-span and eccentric combinations of road and rail loading in the finite-element model, outputting track level, gradient, twist and end rotation; after completion load-test with actual trains and test vehicles, measuring movement by precise levelling and GNSS against prediction.
units.failure: 若只檢核主纜強度而未把變形換算成軌道幾何，可能出現列車通過時坡度或扭曲超限，導致限速、乘客不適或軌道部件加速磨耗；橋端轉角過大則使伸縮裝置處的鋼軌產生額外彎曲與疲勞。~Checking cable strength without converting deformation into track geometry can let gradient or twist exceed limits under trains, forcing speed restrictions, passenger discomfort or faster wear of track components; excessive end rotation adds bending and fatigue to rails at the expansion devices.
units.misconception: 懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。~If a suspension bridge is strong enough, trains can run on it as on the ground.
units.practice: 鐵路營運單位應從初步設計就參與訂定軌道幾何限值與載重組合，設計報告須列出最不利工況下的軌道坡度、扭曲與橋端轉角，並在通車前以載重試驗驗證。~The railway operator should join from preliminary design to set track-geometry limits and load combinations; the design report must list track gradient, twist and end rotation for the worst cases, verified by load tests before opening.

units.anchor: 颱風下的遮蔽車道~Sheltered lanes in typhoons
units.title: 颱風強風與行車安全~Typhoon winds and vehicle safety
units.mechanism: 香港位於颱風路徑上，青馬大橋的橋面高程與跨徑使它暴露在強烈陣風中。結構本身要抵抗顫振與抖振，用路人則面臨側風翻車或偏移的風險。青馬大橋的下層除鐵路外設有兩條有遮蔽的車道，平時供維修通行，在特別強烈的颱風中，上層封閉後可作為行車道；強風時也可把交通改到下層並降低速限。這是把結構斷面設計與營運規則結合的例子：車輛安全的控制條件往往比結構強度的控制風速低得多。~Hong Kong lies on typhoon tracks, and Tsing Ma's deck height and span expose it to strong gusts. The structure must resist flutter and buffeting, while road users face the risk of crosswind overturning or drift. Besides the railway, the lower deck carries two sheltered carriageways used for maintenance access in normal times and as traffic lanes when the upper deck is closed in particularly severe typhoons; in strong winds traffic can also be moved to the lower deck with reduced speed limits. This shows section design and operating rules working together: the wind speed that governs vehicle safety is usually far lower than the one that governs structural strength.
units.model: 風壓 q = ½ρU²。U = 50 m/s 時 q ≈ 1,563 Pa，作用在 10 m² 車側得 15.6 kN；作用高度 1.8 m 的傾覆力矩 28.1 kN·m，小於重量 50 kN×半輪距 1.0 m = 50 kN·m 的抵抗力矩。U = 70 m/s 時 q ≈ 3,063 Pa、側力 30.6 kN、力矩 55.1 kN·m > 50 kN·m，空車可能翻覆。數值為教學假設。~Wind pressure q = ½ρU². At U = 50 m/s, q ≈ 1,563 Pa, giving 15.6 kN on a 10 m² vehicle side; acting at 1.8 m it produces an overturning moment of 28.1 kN·m, below the resisting 50 kN weight × 1.0 m half-track = 50 kN·m. At 70 m/s, q ≈ 3,063 Pa, side force 30.6 kN and moment 55.1 kN·m > 50 kN·m, so an empty vehicle may overturn. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以橋面高度的風速計連續量測平均風與陣風，結合車輛側風試驗或分析訂出分級管制門檻（降速、限制高側車、改道下層、封橋）；每次颱風後檢討實測風速、管制時點與事故紀錄，確認門檻是否需要調整。~Measure mean and gust wind continuously with deck-level anemometers and, with vehicle crosswind tests or analysis, set staged control thresholds (speed reduction, restricting high-sided vehicles, diverting to the lower deck, closure); after each typhoon review measured wind, timing of controls and incident records to see whether thresholds need adjustment.
units.failure: 若管制只依天文台的區域風速而不看橋面實測陣風，可能在橋上陣風已超過安全值時仍開放高側車通行；反之門檻過於保守，則讓重要的機場聯外道路不必要地長時間封閉。~Basing controls only on regional observatory wind instead of measured deck gusts can keep high-sided vehicles moving after gusts on the bridge exceed safe values; overly conservative thresholds needlessly close a vital airport link for long periods.
units.misconception: 橋梁設計能抵抗颱風，車輛在颱風中通過就一定安全。~If the bridge is designed for typhoons, vehicles crossing in a typhoon must be safe.
units.practice: 強風管制程序應由業主、交通主管與警方共同訂定，寫明量測位置、平均時間、各級門檻與通知流程；遮蔽車道的照明、排水、緊急出口與標誌須定期測試，確保颱風時能立即啟用。~Strong-wind procedures should be agreed by the owner, transport authority and police, stating measurement locations, averaging time, staged thresholds and notification chains; lighting, drainage, emergency exits and signs in the sheltered lanes must be tested regularly so they can be used immediately in a typhoon.

units.anchor: 主跨與邊跨鋼絲數~Main- and side-span wire counts
units.title: 空中紡線主纜的邊跨補強絲~Extra side-span wires in the air-spun cables
units.mechanism: 青馬大橋兩條主纜直徑約 1.1 m，由 5.38 mm 鍍鋅鋼絲以空中紡線法架設：鋼絲從恆張力供線裝置拉出，經塔頂約 500 t 的鑄鋼索鞍在兩座錨碇間往返。資料庫記載每條主纜在主跨約 33,400 根鋼絲、邊跨約 35,224 根。邊跨主纜傾角較陡，在相同水平張力下軸向張力較大，因此在邊跨額外加入鋼絲，從索鞍以外到錨碇之間補強，而不必讓整條主纜都加粗。~Tsing Ma's two main cables, each about 1.1 m in diameter, were built from 5.38 mm galvanised wires by aerial spinning: wire drawn from a constant-tension supply was looped between the anchorages over cast saddles of about 500 t on the tower tops. A structures database records about 33,400 wires per cable in the main span and about 35,224 in the side spans. The side-span cables are steeper, so at the same horizontal tension their axial tension is larger; extra wires are therefore added in the side spans between the saddles and anchorages, rather than enlarging the whole cable.
units.model: 單絲面積 22.73 mm²，主跨 A = 33,400×22.73 ≈ 759,300 mm²；毛面積 π/4×1.1² = 0.950 m²，空隙率 ≈ 1 − 0.759/0.950 ≈ 20%。邊跨與主跨鋼絲比 35,224/33,400 ≈ 1.055；若邊跨所需面積只由 T = H/cosθ 決定，cosθ ≈ 1/1.055 = 0.948，θ ≈ 18.5°。以上由公開數據推算，θ 的解讀為教學假設。~Wire area is 22.73 mm², so the main-span cable has A = 33,400×22.73 ≈ 759,300 mm²; gross area π/4×1.1² = 0.950 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 1 − 0.759/0.950 ≈ 20%. The side-to-main wire ratio is 35,224/33,400 ≈ 1.055; if the side-span area were governed only by T = H/cosθ, cosθ ≈ 1/1.055 = 0.948 and θ ≈ 18.5°. Derived from published figures; the angle interpretation is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 紡線時以計數器記錄每束鋼絲數與邊跨補強絲的起訖位置，補強絲的錨固與索鞍內排列須與圖說核對；完成後在主跨與邊跨分別量測直徑與周長，確認兩段的空隙率都在設計範圍。~During spinning count wires per strand and record where the side-span extra wires start and stop, checking their anchorage and arrangement in the saddles against the drawings; afterwards measure diameter and circumference separately in main and side spans to confirm both void ratios are within design range.
units.failure: 補強絲終止處若未妥善錨固或在索鞍內排列錯位，可能造成局部鋼絲受力集中與滑移；空中紡線若在強風中進行，鋼絲擺動使張力不均，壓擠後產生鬆弛絲並影響耐久性。~Poorly anchored or misaligned extra wires at their termination or in the saddles can concentrate force on some wires and let them slip; spinning in strong wind makes wires swing and tension uneven, leaving slack wires after compaction that hurt durability.
units.misconception: 主纜從錨碇到錨碇的鋼絲數一定相同。~A main cable always has the same number of wires from anchorage to anchorage.
units.practice: 主纜竣工圖應標示每段的鋼絲數、補強絲起訖位置與索鞍內排列，交接給維護單位；日後開纜檢查或強度評估時，必須用對應區段的鋼絲數計算剩餘安全係數。~As-built cable drawings should show wire counts per segment, where the extra wires start and stop and their arrangement in the saddles, handed over to the maintainer; later cable openings and strength evaluations must use the wire count for the relevant segment when computing remaining safety factors.

units.anchor: 滑模混凝土塔柱~Slipformed concrete tower legs
units.title: 50 MPa 塔柱的連續滑模~Continuous slipforming of 50 MPa tower legs
units.mechanism: 青馬大橋兩座橋塔為雙柱門形鋼筋混凝土塔，高約 206 m，柱間以間隔的橫桁連接；塔柱使用 50 MPa 高強度混凝土，以連續滑模施工。滑模是一套固定高度的模板，以千斤頂沿預埋的爬桿不分晝夜緩慢上升，混凝土在模板內凝結到足以自立時正好離開模板底部。馬灣側橋塔建在離岸約 120 m 的人工島上，周圍的拋石護岸據稱能阻止 22 萬噸船舶以 8 節速度撞擊，讓塔柱本身不必直接承受船撞。~Tsing Ma's two towers are two-legged reinforced-concrete portals about 206 m high, with legs linked by intermittent cross-trusses; the legs use 50 MPa high-strength concrete placed by continuous slipforming. A slipform is a fixed-height form jacked slowly up climbing rods day and night, so that concrete sets in the form and leaves its bottom just as it can stand on its own. The Ma Wan tower stands on an artificial island about 120 m offshore, whose rock seawall is reported to stop a 220,000 t ship at 8 knots, so the legs themselves need not take a direct ship impact.
units.model: 混凝土在模內停留時間 t = H_f/v。模板高 1.2 m、滑升速度 0.25 m/h：t = 1.2/0.25 = 4.8 h，出模時須達到足以自立且不被拉裂的早期強度。以此速度連續施工，200 m 塔柱約需 200/0.25/24 ≈ 33 天；若因溫度低必須降速到 0.15 m/h，則約需 56 天。數值為教學假設。~Residence time in the form t = H_f/v. With a 1.2 m form and 0.25 m/h slip rate: t = 1.2/0.25 = 4.8 h, and concrete must have enough early strength to stand and not tear when it emerges. At this rate a 200 m leg takes about 200/0.25/24 ≈ 33 days of continuous work; if cold weather forces 0.15 m/h it takes about 56 days. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以出模處的手指按壓或貫入試驗與溫度紀錄判斷早期強度，調整滑升速度與緩凝劑用量；每數公尺以全站儀與雷射垂準儀量測塔柱中心與扭轉，並以標準養護試體確認 50 MPa 的設計強度。~Judge early strength at the form exit by finger-pressure or penetration tests with temperature records, adjusting slip rate and retarder dosage; every few metres survey leg centre and twist with total station and laser plumb, and confirm the 50 MPa design strength with standard-cured specimens.
units.failure: 滑升過快時混凝土強度不足而塌落或被模板拉裂，過慢則混凝土黏附模板形成水平冷縫與表面撕裂；千斤頂不同步會讓模板扭轉，塔柱出現累積的扭曲與偏斜。~Slipping too fast lets weak concrete slump or tear at the form exit, too slow lets it stick to the form and form horizontal cold joints and surface tears; unsynchronised jacks twist the form so the leg accumulates twist and lean.
units.misconception: 滑模越快越好，只要混凝土能泵送上去就行。~Faster slipforming is always better as long as concrete can be pumped up.
units.practice: 滑模施工須有連續作業的人力、材料與停電應變計畫，並訂出強制減速或停滑的條件（例如出模強度不足、垂直度偏差超限）；停滑時的施工縫處理方法要事先核准。~Slipforming needs labour, material and power-failure contingency for continuous work, with mandatory slow-down or stop criteria such as insufficient exit strength or verticality beyond limits; the treatment of construction joints after a stop must be approved in advance.

units.title: 橋面模組製造、運輸與吊裝~Fabrication, transport and lifting of deck modules
units.mechanism: 青馬大橋的鋼橋面由 96 個模組組成，每個長約 18 m、重約 480 t，鋼構在英國與日本製造，於東莞組裝後以駁船運到橋位，再由主纜上的吊裝門架垂直吊起並掛上吊索；第一個節段於 1994 年底吊裝。雙層桁架模組包含上層公路與下層鐵路的橋面系統，因此模組越完整，海上作業越少，但單次吊重越大、對吊裝門架與主纜局部受力的要求越高。吊裝時機要配合潮汐、航道與天氣窗口。~Tsing Ma's steel deck comprises 96 modules, each about 18 m long and about 480 t; the steel was fabricated in Britain and Japan, assembled in Dongguan and brought by barge to the site, where lifting gantries on the main cables hoisted each module and attached it to the hangers, the first segment going up in late 1994. Each double-deck truss module includes the road deck above and the rail deck below, so more complete modules mean less marine work but heavier lifts and higher demands on the gantries and local cable forces. Lifts must fit tidal, navigation and weather windows.
units.model: 全橋鋼構約 49,000 t ÷ 2,160 m ≈ 22.7 t/m；模組 480 t ÷ 18 m ≈ 26.7 t/m（含部分橋面系統）。吊裝設計重量考慮 1.1 動力係數為 480×1.1 = 528 t；若門架以四個吊點均分，每點約 132 t。動力係數與吊點配置為教學假設。~Total steelwork of about 49,000 t ÷ 2,160 m ≈ 22.7 t/m; a module of 480 t ÷ 18 m ≈ 26.7 t/m (including part of the deck system). With a 1.1 dynamic factor the design lift is 480×1.1 = 528 t; shared equally by four lifting points, each carries about 132 t. Dynamic factor and lifting arrangement are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個模組出廠前量測長度、對角線與接頭孔位，並稱重確認重心；吊裝前檢查門架行走與鎖定、吊索與千斤頂讀值，吊起後量測模組高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較。~Before shipment measure each module's length, diagonals and joint holes and weigh it to confirm the centre of gravity; before lifting check gantry travel and locking, hoist ropes and jack readings; after lifting measure module level and cable sag against the stage analysis step by step.
units.failure: 模組實際重量或重心與設計不符，會使吊點受力不均、模組傾斜並碰撞已安裝節段；駁船定位不良或在潮流變化時起吊，可能造成擺盪與吊具過載。~A module whose weight or centre of gravity differs from design loads lifting points unevenly, tilting it into installed segments; poor barge positioning or lifting as the tide turns can cause swinging and overload the rigging.
units.misconception: 模組在工廠做得越大越好，吊裝風險不會因此增加。~The bigger the factory-made module the better; lifting risk does not grow.
units.practice: 吊裝計畫須列出每一吊次的重量、重心、潮汐窗口、最大風速與航道協調，並設吊離底板後暫停檢查的停留點；任何模組重量偏差超過允差都要先由設計者評估。~The lifting plan must list each lift's weight, centre of gravity, tidal window, maximum wind speed and navigation coordination, with a hold point to pause and check once the module clears the barge; any weight deviation beyond tolerance needs the designer's assessment first.

units.anchor: 伸縮縫與鐵路調節器~Joints and rail expansion devices
units.title: 伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續~Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity
units.mechanism: 懸索橋橋面的縱向位移包括溫度、活載下主纜變形帶動的位移與風、地震造成的移動。資料庫記載青馬大橋伸縮縫的溫度位移約 ±835 mm。公路伸縮縫可用模數式裝置容納，鐵路則需要鋼軌伸縮調節器，讓鋼軌在橋梁與路堤之間滑動而保持軌距與平順。安裝時必須依當時的橋面溫度設定開口，並確認全橋完工荷重已到位，否則溫度與荷重造成的位移會讓裝置在一端提早頂死。~Longitudinal movement of a suspension deck comes from temperature, from cable deformation under live load and from wind and earthquake. A structures database records the thermal movement at Tsing Ma's expansion joints as about ±835 mm. Road joints can absorb this with modular devices, but rail needs rail expansion devices that let the rail slide between bridge and embankment while keeping gauge and smoothness. At installation the opening must be set for the deck temperature at the time, and the full completed dead load must already be in place, otherwise thermal and load movement will make the device bottom out early at one end.
units.model: 純溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取等效長度 L = 1,000 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、相對於安裝溫度 ±20 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m。與 ±835 mm 比較，可知其餘大部分位移來自活載與風引起的縱向移動，因此不能只用溫度決定裝置行程。L 與 ΔT 為教學假設。~Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With an effective length L = 1,000 m, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C and ±20 °C from the installation temperature: ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m. Compared with about ±835 mm, most of the remaining movement comes from longitudinal motion under live load and wind, so device travel cannot be set from temperature alone. L and ΔT are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證；通車前以列車與車隊試驗量測伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的位移、軌距與高差，並以長期位移計確認位移—溫度關係符合預測。~Before installation measure deck and steel temperatures, compute the opening from the preset table and have it witnessed; before opening measure joint and rail-device movement, gauge and level difference under train and vehicle tests, and confirm with long-term displacement transducers that movement follows the predicted temperature relation.
units.failure: 預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。~A wrong preset opening can bottom out the device in summer or strong wind, pushing large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages; a rail expansion device moving beyond its range can change gauge and level enough to force speed restrictions or stop trains.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫的行程只要按溫度變化計算就夠了。~Expansion-joint travel only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
units.practice: 伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的安裝程序要由橋梁與鐵路兩方共同簽認，記錄安裝溫度、開口與當時的施工荷重狀態；營運期把兩者的位移資料放在同一監測平台判讀。~The installation procedure for road joints and rail expansion devices should be signed by both bridge and railway parties, recording installation temperature, opening and the construction-load state at the time; in service interpret both sets of movement data on one monitoring platform.

units.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計~Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system
units.mechanism: 香港路政署為策略性長跨橋梁維持一套專用的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS），青馬大橋與汀九橋、汲水門大橋同在其中。系統以風速計量測來流，加速度計、GNSS、位移計、溫度計與應變計記錄橋梁反應，並把資料集中處理。不同感測器各有適用頻帶：GNSS 直接量測位移，適合長週期的大變位；加速度計對高頻敏感，但積分成低頻位移時誤差會快速累積。設計監測系統就是讓每一個要回答的工程問題都有適合的感測器。~Hong Kong's Highways Department maintains a dedicated Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS) for strategic long-span bridges, with Tsing Ma alongside Ting Kau and Kap Shui Mun. Anemometers measure incoming wind; accelerometers, GNSS, displacement transducers, thermometers and strain gauges record the bridge's response, and data are processed centrally. Each sensor has its own useful frequency band: GNSS measures displacement directly and suits large long-period movement, while accelerometers are sensitive at high frequency but accumulate error quickly when integrated to low-frequency displacement. Designing a monitoring system means giving each engineering question a suitable sensor.
units.model: 簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。若某模態 f = 0.10 Hz、加速度振幅 a = 0.02 m/s²：(2πf)² = 0.395，A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m（約 5 cm）。GNSS 精度約 1 至 2 cm 即可分辨；若同樣加速度發生在 1.0 Hz，位移只有約 0.5 mm，必須靠加速度計。數值為教學假設。~Harmonic displacement A = a/(2πf)². For a mode at f = 0.10 Hz with acceleration amplitude a = 0.02 m/s²: (2πf)² = 0.395 and A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m (about 5 cm), which GNSS at 1 to 2 cm accuracy can resolve; the same acceleration at 1.0 Hz gives only about 0.5 mm, which needs accelerometers. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性；GNSS 與加速度計在重疊頻帶內互相比對，風速計則比對不同位置的平均風速；建立資料完整率與異常值的每月報告。~Calibrate every sensor type before installation, then check signal plausibility against known events such as train passages and daily temperature cycles; compare GNSS and accelerometers in their overlapping band and anemometers across locations; issue monthly reports on data completeness and outliers.
units.failure: 若感測器配置只追求數量而沒有對應的工程問題，系統會累積大量無人判讀的資料；時間不同步或座標方向錯誤，則會讓模態辨識與風—反應關係完全失真。~A layout driven by sensor count rather than engineering questions piles up data nobody interprets; unsynchronised clocks or wrong axis orientation completely distort mode identification and wind–response relationships.
units.misconception: 感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。~The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety.
units.practice: 監測系統規格應從「要回答哪些問題」出發，列出每個問題的感測器、取樣率、精度與判讀責任人；資料格式、時間同步與後設資料（位置、方向、校正）須文件化，以便感測器更換後仍能延續長期序列。~Specify the monitoring system from the questions it must answer, listing for each the sensors, sampling rate, accuracy and the person responsible for interpretation; document data format, time synchronisation and metadata (location, orientation, calibration) so long-term series continue after sensor replacement.

units.anchor: 颱風抖振紀錄~Typhoon buffeting records
units.title: 以颱風紀錄驗證抖振反應~Checking buffeting response against typhoon records
units.mechanism: 抖振是紊流中的陣風對橋面持續施加隨機力所引起的振動，不會像顫振那樣發散，但決定了颱風中橋面的位移、加速度與構件應力循環。準靜態理論顯示，抖振力與平均風速平方成正比，因此反應的均方根值大致隨風速平方增長；若某次颱風的實測反應明顯偏離歷次紀錄的趨勢，可能代表風向特殊、感測器問題，或結構阻尼、勁度出現變化。長期累積的颱風紀錄因此成為判斷橋梁狀態的重要基準。~Buffeting is vibration caused by gusts in turbulent wind applying a continuous random force to the deck; it does not diverge like flutter, but it sets deck displacement, acceleration and member stress cycles in a typhoon. Quasi-steady theory makes buffeting force proportional to the square of mean wind speed, so the RMS response grows roughly with wind speed squared; if a typhoon's measured response departs clearly from the trend of earlier records, it may indicate an unusual wind direction, a sensor problem or a change in structural damping or stiffness. Accumulated typhoon records therefore become an important baseline for judging the bridge's condition.
units.model: 準靜態近似 σ ≈ k·U²。若平均風速 20 m/s 時側向位移均方根 σ = 0.05 m，則 35 m/s 時 σ ≈ 0.05×(35/20)² ≈ 0.153 m；若實測為 0.25 m，比趨勢高約 63%，應先排查風向與紊流，再檢查阻尼與支承狀態。數值為教學假設。~Quasi-steady approximation σ ≈ k·U². If the lateral RMS displacement is σ = 0.05 m at a 20 m/s mean wind, at 35 m/s σ ≈ 0.05×(35/20)² ≈ 0.153 m; a measured 0.25 m would be about 63% above trend, prompting checks first of wind direction and turbulence, then of damping and bearing condition. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 把每次颱風的資料按 10 分鐘平均風速、風向與紊流強度分段，繪出反應均方根與風速的對數圖，擬合指數與係數；新事件落在歷史信賴區間之外時，啟動資料品質檢查與結構檢查，並比較辨識出的模態頻率與阻尼。~Bin each typhoon's data by 10-minute mean wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity, plot RMS response against wind speed on log axes and fit exponent and coefficient; when a new event falls outside the historical confidence band, start data-quality and structural checks and compare identified modal frequencies and damping.
units.failure: 若不分風向、紊流就把所有紀錄混在一起擬合，趨勢線過於分散而失去預警能力；只看最大值而不看統計，也容易把單一陣風或感測器尖峰誤判為結構異常。~Fitting all records together without separating wind direction and turbulence makes the trend too scattered to give warning; looking only at maxima rather than statistics easily mistakes a single gust or sensor spike for a structural anomaly.
units.misconception: 颱風過後橋梁沒有損壞，監測資料就沒有分析的必要。~If a bridge is undamaged after a typhoon, its monitoring data need not be analysed.
units.practice: 每次達到預設風速門檻的颱風都應產出事件報告，包含風況、反應統計、與歷史趨勢的比較及現場檢查結果，並歸檔於資產管理系統；趨勢模型每數年依新資料更新。~Every typhoon above a preset wind threshold should produce an event report with wind conditions, response statistics, comparison with the historical trend and field inspection findings, filed in the asset system; update the trend model every few years with new data.

units.anchor: 公路與鐵路疲勞循環~Road and rail fatigue cycles
units.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命~Traffic growth and fatigue life
units.mechanism: 青馬大橋同時承受公路車流與鐵路列車，鋼桁架節點、吊索端部與橋面系統焊道都在每次重車或列車通過時經歷應力循環。運輸署統計顯示，大嶼山幹線在 2016 年的日均車流約 87,764 架次，全年約 3,210 萬架次，且十年間持續成長。疲勞設計通常以設計當時的交通預測為基礎，若實際交通量與重車比例增長更快，累積損傷會提早到達，因此營運期要以實際交通與應變量測更新剩餘壽命。~Tsing Ma carries both road traffic and trains, and steel truss joints, hanger ends and deck welds go through a stress cycle with every heavy vehicle or train. Transport Department statistics show an average daily flow of about 87,764 vehicles on the Lantau Link in 2016, about 32.1 million a year, growing steadily over the decade. Fatigue design is usually based on traffic forecasts made at design time; if traffic and the heavy-vehicle share grow faster, accumulated damage arrives early, so remaining life must be updated in service with actual traffic and strain measurements.
units.model: S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。取細部類別 Δσ_C = 90 MPa、等效應力範圍 Δσ = 15 MPa：N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ 次。若每年 3.2×10⁶ 次有效重車循環，壽命約 135 年；若重車循環增加 50% 到 4.8×10⁶ 次/年，壽命降為約 90 年。數值為教學假設。~S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. With detail category Δσ_C = 90 MPa and equivalent stress range Δσ = 15 MPa: N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ cycles. At 3.2×10⁶ effective heavy-vehicle cycles a year the life is about 135 years; if heavy cycles grow 50% to 4.8×10⁶ a year, the life falls to about 90 years. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷；同時取得動態地磅或交通統計，建立車流與損傷的關係，定期以磁粉或超音波檢查熱點。~Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage; obtain weigh-in-motion or traffic statistics to relate traffic to damage, and inspect hot spots periodically by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing.
units.failure: 疲勞裂縫多從焊趾或螺栓孔開始，初期很小且被塗層遮蔽，若檢查頻率不足，裂縫可能擴展到主要構件；鐵路列車的軸重與頻率若高於設計假設，橋面系統的縱梁與橫梁連接最先受影響。~Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members. If train axle loads and frequency exceed design assumptions, stringer-to-floor-beam connections in the deck system are affected first.
units.misconception: 疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。~Fatigue depends only on the heaviest vehicle, not on how much traffic there is.
units.practice: 營運單位應每年把交通統計與疲勞監測資料送交結構工程師更新剩餘壽命，並依結果調整熱點檢查頻率；重大交通政策改變（例如收費或路網調整）前後，應比較重車循環數的變化。~The operator should send traffic statistics and fatigue monitoring data to the structural engineer each year to update remaining life and adjust hot-spot inspection frequency; before and after major traffic-policy changes such as tolling or network changes, compare the number of heavy-vehicle cycles.

units.anchor: 水上淨空管制時段~Marine air-draft control hours
units.title: 橋下維修與航運協調~Under-deck maintenance and shipping coordination
units.mechanism: 懸索橋的橋面下方檢查、塗裝與構件更換常需要吊籃、工作平台或移動式維修門架，它們會降低橋下的有效淨空。香港路政署依《船舶及港口管制規例》與《商船（本地船隻）（一般）規例》發布公告，指定船舶進入青馬大橋範圍須遵守的時段，分全日與部分時段管制，並設 24 小時熱線。維修規劃因此不只是結構問題，而是要把作業高度、時段與航道使用協調起來，並讓船公司提前知道。~Under-deck inspection, painting and component replacement on a suspension bridge often need cradles, platforms or travelling gantries that reduce the effective clearance beneath the deck. Hong Kong's Highways Department issues notices under the Shipping and Port Control Regulations and the Merchant Shipping (Local Vessels)(General) Regulation specifying hours that apply to vessels entering the Tsing Ma Bridge area, with full-day and part-day restrictions and a 24-hour hotline. Maintenance planning is thus not only a structural question but one of coordinating working heights, hours and channel use, and telling ship operators in advance.
units.model: 橋面下表面積估算 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m²。若一部維修門架每夜可完成約 600 m² 的近距離檢查，全面檢查需約 88,560/600 ≈ 148 個夜間作業；若只能在每月約 17 個全日管制日中工作，約需 9 個月。產能與管制日數為教學假設。~Deck underside area ≈ 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m². If one maintenance gantry completes close inspection of about 600 m² a night, a full inspection needs about 88,560/600 ≈ 148 night shifts; if work is allowed only on about 17 full-restriction days a month, it takes about 9 months. Productivity and restriction days are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。~Before each shift confirm the notified hours and the lowest point of gantries and cradles, converting measured levels to clearance at the current tide; afterwards record inspection coverage and findings in the component database and track the schedule for areas not yet done.
units.failure: 若維修設備在非管制時段伸出橋下或高度超出預告，可能與通過的船舶碰撞；檢查只在方便的區段進行而沒有覆蓋紀錄，則某些區段可能多年未被近距離檢查。~Maintenance equipment protruding below the deck outside notified hours or above announced levels can be struck by passing ships; inspections done only where convenient, without coverage records, can leave some zones uninspected at close range for years.
units.misconception: 橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。~Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping.
units.practice: 長期維修計畫應包含年度的水上淨空管制時段需求，提前與海事主管協調並公告；交接文件要列出維修門架的運行範圍、最低高程與緊急收回程序。~The long-term maintenance plan should include the annual need for air-draft control hours, coordinated and announced early with the marine authority; handover documents should list the operating range, lowest level and emergency retraction procedure of the maintenance gantries.

example: 設計練習：估算青馬大橋型懸索橋在公路與鐵路同時加載時的主纜張力增量。假設主跨 l = 1,377 m、垂跨比 1/11（f ≈ 125.2 m），每條主纜主跨鋼絲面積 A ≈ 0.759 m²。公路六車道各 20 kN/m 的 30% 同時作用（36 kN/m），加上兩軌列車各 60 kN/m 的 50%（60 kN/m），總活載 96 kN/m，每纜 48 kN/m。張力增量 ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN，鋼絲應力增量 ≈ 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm²。若列車改為兩軌全滿（120 kN/m），每纜活載 78 kN/m，ΔH ≈ 148 MN、應力增量約 195 N/mm²，顯示鐵路荷載假設對主纜應力幅與疲勞評估的影響。數值為教學假設，不代表青馬大橋的設計計算。~Design exercise: estimate the main-cable tension increase on a Tsing Ma type suspension bridge under combined road and rail loading. Assume main span l = 1,377 m, sag ratio 1/11 (f ≈ 125.2 m) and main-span wire area per cable A ≈ 0.759 m². Take 30% of 20 kN/m on each of six road lanes acting together (36 kN/m) plus 50% of 60 kN/m on each of two tracks (60 kN/m), a total live load of 96 kN/m, or 48 kN/m per cable. The tension increase ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN, a wire stress increase of about 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm². With both tracks fully loaded (120 kN/m) the live load per cable becomes 78 kN/m, ΔH ≈ 148 MN and the stress increase about 195 N/mm², showing how rail-load assumptions drive cable stress range and fatigue assessment. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of Tsing Ma Bridge.
history: 青馬大橋是連接香港赤鱲角新機場與市區的大嶼山幹線核心，由 Mott MacDonald 設計，Costain、三井與 Trafalgar House 組成的英日聯營承建，1992 年 5 月動工，1997 年 4 月 27 日主持揭幕、5 月 22 日通車。它以 1,377 m 主跨在完工時為世界第二長的懸索橋，至今仍是承載鐵路的最長跨徑橋梁；雙層桁架讓公路、機場鐵路與颱風時的遮蔽車道共用一個斷面。香港路政署以 WASHMS 長期監測此橋與相鄰的汲水門、汀九兩橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Tsing Ma Bridge is the core of the Lantau Link connecting Hong Kong's new airport at Chek Lap Kok with the urban area; designed by Mott MacDonald and built by the Anglo Japanese Construction joint venture of Costain, Mitsui and Trafalgar House, it began in May 1992, was inaugurated on 27 April 1997 and opened on 22 May 1997. Its 1,377 m main span was the world's second longest suspension span on completion, and it is still the longest-span bridge carrying rail; the double-deck truss lets road, the airport railway and typhoon-sheltered lanes share one section. The Highways Department monitors it, together with the neighbouring Kap Shui Mun and Ting Kau bridges, through WASHMS. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 懸索橋主跨 1,377 m，橋梁全長約 2,160 m~Main span 1,377 m, total length about 2,160 m
混凝土門形橋塔高約 206 m，塔柱使用 50 MPa 高強度混凝土滑模施工~Concrete portal towers about 206 m high, legs slipformed in 50 MPa high-strength concrete
兩條主纜直徑約 1.1 m，由 5.38 mm 鍍鋅鋼絲空中紡線而成，主跨每纜約 33,400 根~Two main cables about 1.1 m in diameter, air-spun from 5.38 mm galvanised wires, about 33,400 per cable in the main span
上層六線公路，下層兩條鐵路軌道與兩條遮蔽車道，橋面寬約 41 m~Six road lanes above, two rail tracks and two sheltered carriageways below; deck about 41 m wide
橋面由 96 個約 18 m 長、約 480 t 的模組組成~The deck is made of 96 modules, each about 18 m long and about 480 t
青衣與馬灣重力式錨碇的混凝土分別約 200,000 t 與 250,000 t~Gravity anchorages at Tsing Yi and Ma Wan contain about 200,000 t and 250,000 t of concrete
1997 年 5 月 22 日通車，雙層斷面供公路與鐵路使用~Opened to traffic on 22 May 1997; its double deck serves road and rail
大嶼山幹線 2016 年日均車流約 87,764 架次~Average daily traffic on the Lantau Link was about 87,764 vehicles in 2016
